summary: Indian stocks are drifting lower in a tight range through late morning, as profit-taking after a three-day rally and rate-hike worries keep buyers away, with banks the main drag.

detail.leaders: Pharma and healthcare, still the firmest sectors
detail.laggards: Bank shares, the main drag; rate-sensitive realty and autos
detail.tone: A live read of late-morning trade. A touch weaker than the previous note, with the market holding just below where it was. No index print newer than the previous note's was found, so this is a read on behaviour.
watch: Any change in expectations for a December RBI hike
